reason: My renderer is gone and I have clients asking to see homes before we break ground, so a no-deposit sample of one of my own plans, paid only if I like it, is hard to say no to. Fifteen hundred a home is small against what a change order costs me.
objection: I don't know if these people will still be around next year, and I don't have the time to run a vendor. If the renders don't match how we actually build and finish, I'm back to square one.
would_change_my_mind: If the sample from my own plan looked off on finishes or layout, or if they couldn't show me a couple of other Utah builders using them.
